title: Odoo System Admin
tagline: Learn to manage users, permissions, applications, company settings, data quality, and operational support.
description: Odoo administrators keep the platform organized, secure, and usable across departments. Their decisions influence what users can see, how records are structured, and whether teams can follow the intended process.
This course focuses on operational administration rather than programming, preparing learners to manage access, settings, data, workflows, and day-to-day platform support.
learningOutcomes: Manage users, roles, groups, and access permissions
Configure company and operational settings responsibly
Understand applications, module relationships, and change impact
Improve record structure and data quality
Support users and troubleshoot common administration issues
whoItsFor: Experienced end users taking on more responsibility for the system and its users
Office administrators managing internal structure, access, and operational settings
ERP support teams resolving common user, data, permission, and configuration issues
Operations leads maintaining reliable workflows across teams and departments
requirements: Basic Odoo navigation and end-user experience
Understanding of at least one business workflow

curriculum.title: System Admin Foundations
curriculum.description: Understand administrator responsibilities and the impact of configuration decisions.

curriculum.title: Users, Groups, and Access Rights
curriculum.description: Create users, assign groups, control permissions, and separate departmental access.

curriculum.title: Companies and Operational Settings
curriculum.description: Configure companies, departments, sequences, languages, and shared settings.

curriculum.title: Applications and Module Dependencies
curriculum.description: Understand installed apps, dependencies, configuration flow, and safe change management.

curriculum.title: Data Structure and Quality
curriculum.description: Organize master data, prevent duplication, import carefully, and establish clear ownership.

curriculum.title: Workflow Support and Monitoring
curriculum.description: Support teams, monitor usage, diagnose permission problems, and improve adoption.

curriculum.title: Administration Capstone
curriculum.description: Configure a multi-role company environment and resolve a realistic set of admin issues.

projects.title: Multi-Role Access Design
projects.description: Create users and permissions for Sales, Inventory, Accounting, and management roles.

projects.title: Company Configuration Audit
projects.description: Review settings, master data, access risks, and operational consistency.

projects.title: Admin Support Simulation
projects.description: Diagnose and resolve common access, configuration, and data-quality problems.

faq.question: Does this course teach server administration?
faq.answer: The main focus is functional and operational Odoo administration. Hosting and advanced infrastructure are outside the core scope.

faq.question: Do I need to know Python?
faq.answer: No. This course focuses on users, access, settings, data, and operational support rather than development.

faq.question: Is this a prerequisite for implementation?
faq.answer: It is not always mandatory, but it provides a valuable foundation for learners moving into implementation work.

faq.question: Will access-right scenarios be included?
faq.answer: Yes. The exercises include designing and testing access for multiple business roles.
